en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn AbuUmeyr, from Abu Al Magra, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the man who leases a land, then he sub-leases it out with more than what he had leased it for. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. This is not like the shops, nor like the employees (wages). The excess of the wages and the shops is Prohibited’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu al-Mighra’ who has said the following: “

About the case of a man who leases a piece of land, then rents it to someone for more than what he has leased for, he (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘It is not unlawful because it is not like a shop or wages; increase of wages and rent of shop is not lawful.’”
